sn14.4:1.2: Dhātunānattam bhikkhave paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ || phassanānattam paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ || || 3
sn14.4:2.1: Kathañca bhikkhave dhātunānattam paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattam || phassanānattam paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ || || 6
sn14.4:2.2: Cakkhudhātum bhikkhave paṭicca uppajjati cakkhusamphasso || cakkhusamphassam paṭicca uppajjati cakkhusamphassajā vedanā || ||
sn14.4:2.3: Manodhātum paṭicca uppajjati manosamphasso || manosamphassam paṭicca uppajjati manosamphassajā vedanā || || 7
sn14.4:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave dhātunānattam paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattam || phassanānattam paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattanti || ||
